name: Louanna Astrea
japaneseName: ルアンナ・アストレア
description: Louanna Astrea is the wife of Heinkel Astrea and the mother of Reinhard van Astrea. Afflicted years ago by the mysterious 'Sleeping Beauty' ailment that suspended her physical aging in an indefinite coma, her condition remains the tragic core of the Astrea family's estrangement, brought up in Arc 5.
